articles.summary: STRASBURG, Va., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First National Corporation (the “Company” or “First National”) (NASDAQ: FXNC), the bank holding company of First Bank (the “Bank”), announced its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.19 per share to shareholders of record on November 27, 2026, to be paid on December 11, 2026. This is an increase of 11.8% from the previous quarterly dividend payment of $0.17 per share. “We are pleased to announce this increase in dividends for our shareholders based on our strong financial performance. We have increased our annual cash dividend payout every year for the past eleven years ,” said Scott Harvard, President and Chief Executive Officer of First National. ABOUT FIRST NATIONAL CORPORATION First National Corporation (NASDAQ: FXNC) is the parent company and bank holding company of First Bank, a community bank that first opened for business in 1907 in Strasburg, Virginia.
